summary: Explains how entropy labels, which help MPLS routers spread traffic over parallel links, should be used with Segment Routing tunnels. Segment Routing builds long label stacks, so the document describes how to place the entropy label so load balancing still works.

eli5.summary: When a road has many lanes, cars should spread out instead of crowding one. A special tag helps routers share the load, and this says where to put the tag.
